mentions.name: download-manager
mentions.description: A command-line download manager written in Rust. It has a working blocking version and an async implementation built on tokio, with planned support for downloading chunks with multiple workers and a download queue.
mentions.source_excerpt: Trying to relearn Rust by writing a download manager CLI. Managed to get the blocking version working, now I've implemented the async version using tokio. Have to next implement downloading chunks with different workers, and a download queue.
